Class PageHeader

java.lang.Object
org.roux.page.PageHeader
public final class PageHeader extends Object
The PageHeader type reads and writes the 64-byte header at the start of a page. init(MemorySegment, int, int) writes the bytes R, O, U, and X. The version written is 2. A new page starts with the hot flag from PageFlags. The header stores the page id, the generation, the used bytes, and a checksum. The checksum is a CRC32C value. The header stores the frame count, the first message id, the last message id, and the next page id. The type refuses construction. // @aa-sdd L40 aa-sdd-source-prose.md#PageHeader roux-design.md

  • Method Details

    • init

      public static void init(MemorySegment segment, int pageId, int pageBytes)
      The method clears the page and writes a new header. The magic bytes are R, O, U, and X. The version is 2. The used-byte count starts at the header size. The capacity argument is accepted and is not written.
      Parameters:
      segment - The segment is the page.
      pageId - The page id is the number stored in the header.
      pageBytes - The capacity is accepted and is not written.

    • writeCrc

      public static void writeCrc(MemorySegment segment)
      The method writes a CRC32C checksum of the used bytes. The checksum skips the four checksum bytes themselves. The covered range is the used prefix of the page.
      Parameters:
      segment - The segment is the page.
